_doc: Pearl's town map descriptions (the user's dump, bank 556, through b2tools/gen4_text.py), appended after Black 2's 163 town_map lines in this order (b2tools/patches/town_map.py text_line; regenerate with python3 b2tools/patches/town_map.py --text). Each Sinnoh place shows its area's line, a cave or lake its landmark line, as Pearl's top screen does.

town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl002: A small path through a lush, green,\nwooded area. The densely grown trees\ngive off a thick aroma.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl003: A winding path that twists through\ngrassy fields. Young Trainers like to\ntest their battle skills here.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl004: Despite being so close to a big town,\nthis path retains its relaxed, natural\natmosphere.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl005: Once one gets through the tunnel,\nthe city of Oreburgh is just a stone’s\nthrow away.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl006: A charmingly natural path that wanders\npast many ponds and groves of trees.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl007: The Ravaged Path was hewn through\na rocky outcropping. It is a shortcut\nthat leads straight to Floaroma Town.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl008: A wide, wooden walkway spans a large\npond. Fishermen idle their time away\ndangling lines from the walkway.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl009: A quietly flowing stream and hilly\nterrain with one-way ledges make this\na fun area for adventure.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl011: Smoothly paved in asphalt, the Cycling\nRoad is heavenly for bicycle lovers.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl012: Below the Cycling Road, one can see\nthe entrance to Wayward Cave.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl013: Located at the foot of Mt. Coronet,\nthis road is carved into the rugged,\nrocky terrain.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl014: A lush field of grass spreads from\nMt. Coronet’s sheer rock face,\ncreating a vista of contrasts.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl016: The streams forded by this path wind\npast copses and grassy patches in\na serene and soothing manner.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl017: The Lost Tower is where Pokémon are\nlaid to rest when their lives come\nto an end.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl018: A path made by clearing an overgrown\ncanyon between mountains. It is always\nshrouded by a dense fog.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl020: This narrow route is lined with deep,\ntall grass that tickles the noses of\npeople straying off the path.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl022: A mountain path that tunnels through\nMt. Coronet, one of the tallest\nmountains in Sinnoh.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl023: A tall, sturdy wall surrounds an\nexpansive estate that takes up nearly\nhalf of the road space.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl024:
Beyond the wall, one can see the
stately Pokémon Mansion and the
owner’s prized garden behind it.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl025: This path weaves among deep puddles\nmade by the unending rainfall. It is\nwet and miserable for Trainers.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl027: Offshore boulders form a jetty that\nbecalms waves reaching the beach.\nA resort hotel overlooks the water.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl029: The road joining Veilstone City and a\nlake is described as either “wildly\nnatural” or simply “a mess.”
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl031: This area is always inundated by heavy\nrainfall. Only hardy Trainers that can\ntake the rain gather here.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl032: This mountainous road leads from Mt.\nCoronet. Its constant snowfall and\ndeep snowdrifts impede travelers.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl033: Snow blows down from Mt. Coronet and\ngrows into a harsh, ceaseless blizzard.\nBe prepared for the worst.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl034: Despite its shortness, this road is\nrevered by fishing enthusiasts as a\ngreat, yet little known, fishing spot.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl035: A beautiful white-sand beach only five\nseconds on foot from Sandgem Town.\nA pleasant breeze blows from the sea.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl036: The sea here is perfect for swimming,\nwith gentle winds and tides. There are\nsandbars for resting, too.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl037: A straight path hemmed by green grass\nand sparse stands of trees.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl039: A sandy beach extends from the road.\nThe beach is busy with avid Fishermen\nhappily casting at the water’s edge.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl041: A marine route that requires travelers\nto navigate around jutting rocks and\nsandbars.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl042: With grass fields, rocky outcroppings,\nthe sea, and sandbars, this area is\nlike a miniature of the Sinnoh region.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl043: The path makes its way up and down\namong rocky outcroppings. It is\nphysically challenging.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl044: A path that winds precariously along\nsheer cliffs that go right to the edge\nof the sea’s pounding waves.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl046: A rugged and steep mountain path\nwhere vision is limited by steadily\nfalling volcanic ash.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl047: This rough path is harshly raked by\na horizontally blowing sandstorm\ndriven by strong winds off the sea.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl048: A seaside path that makes its way\nthrough wildly growing trees and\nplants.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl049: A sea route that stretches from west\nto east. There is an island that is\nrich with plant life along the way.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl051: A small town with the fresh scent\nof new leaves in the air. It feels\nlike a place where adventures start.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl053: A sandy town that is located right\nnext to a beach. It is redolent with\nthe salty scent of the sea.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl055: A town of flower lovers, Floaroma Town\nis always perfumed with the sweet\nscent of flowers.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl056: A short, floral pathway opens up to\na sprawling sea of flowers in bloom.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl058: The temperate climate makes this town\na relaxed and casual place for people\nand Pokémon to live in.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl060: Beyond a path hemmed by stands of\ntrees, one can find the entrance\nto the Solaceon Ruins.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl061: A tiny town that preserves the history\nof Sinnoh and the old ways of life.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl063: A city where hot-blooded Trainers\ngather to work out and hone their\nbattling skills.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl064: A city that attracts Trainers who\nknow there are other ways of enjoying\nPokémon than battling.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl065: The most modernized city in the Sinnoh\nregion. It is bustling with people on\nthe go.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl070: A port city that is bisected by a\ncanal. It has a distinctly exotic air\nof foreign culture.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl073: A vibrant and energetic mining town\nthat is blessed with a precious natural\nresource.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl076: Huge deposits of coal still sleep\nunderneath the ground. The entrance\nto the Oreburgh Coal Mine is here.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl077: An old city that shows fading and\nalmost-forgotten vestiges of ancient\nhistory.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl081: This friendly city started as a place\nwhere people and Pokémon gathered,\nthen grew into a center of commerce.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl086: This city was originally founded to\nprotect the Great Marsh. It has grown\nnaturally over the years.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl089: This city was made by carving out\nsteep, rocky mountains. Its isolation\nlimits its contact with other cities.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl094: A port city that was built around the\nbay portion of the cape. It is criss-\ncrossed by elevated walkways.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl097: A winter wonderland of a city where\nstout trees and buildings are blanketed\nin thick snow.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl098: The Gym is at the heart of the city.\nTo the north is the Snowpoint Temple.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl099: Trainers seeking to become the best\narrive here after enduring a long and\ngrueling journey.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl101: Victory Road is the last and toughest\nof the challenges leading up to the\nPokémon League.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl102: A tiny port town where Trainers who\nlove battling more than eating gather.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl105: One of the lakes that is symbolic of\nthe water-rich Sinnoh region. There is\nan odd legend associated with it.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl107: One of the lakes that is symbolic of\nthe water-rich Sinnoh region. There is\nan odd legend associated with it.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl110: One of the lakes that is symbolic of\nthe water-rich Sinnoh region. There is\nan odd legend associated with it.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl112: The fourth lake of Sinnoh that was\nkept secret.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl114: Numerous wind turbines stand in the\nvicinity of the Valley Windworks.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl116: A forest enveloped in chilly air.\nThick stands of trees turn the forest\ninto a natural maze.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl117: Deep in the forest is the Old Chateau.\nIt is falling into disrepair after\nbeing abandoned by its owner.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl118: The sprawling ironworks is located\nwith the forest at its back.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl120: A sacred mountain that is capped the\nyear round with snow. A gigantic maze\nsprawls inside it.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl123: A rugged, seemingly indestructible rock\nmountain that is thickly blanketed by\nthe volcanic ash it spews.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl124: Inside the mountain, fissures in spilled\nand hardened lava form enormous\ncaverns.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl126: A small, ore-rich island that is\noff the coast of Eterna City.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl127: Inside the island are remnants of an\niron ore mining operation from the\npast.
town_map.+TownMap_Text_Pearl129: The Battle Tower--where the best of\nthe best Trainers gather to test\ntheir skill--is located here.
